adaptation: Users-only organization/task subset. Modular schema 1.2 is flattened to schema 1.1. Parent task and organization hierarchies, service accounts, groups and specialized roles are omitted; retained relation rewrites preserve the documented Openlane semantics.
dataset: Synthetic lab organizations, users and tasks; no upstream users or production data
api_scope: A Rust/Axum lab for organizations, ownership, task assignment, grants, inherited rights and explicit denial; this is not the Openlane server
